shots.scene: 欣欣站在三台外形相似的柜子前，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of three similar-looking lab cabinets in a row and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这三个柜子，你分得清吗？
overlay: 三个柜子不一样：通风柜、超净台、生物安全柜

shots.scene: 三台柜子依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The three cabinets light up one after another: a chemical fume hood, a clean bench, and a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 今天讲它们各自护的是谁。

shots.scene: 阿杰端着细菌培养皿走向超净台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a stack of bacterial culture dishes toward a clean bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰要做细菌实验，直奔超净台。

shots.scene: 老周端着一瓶有机溶剂走向生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The older man carries a solvent bottle with a flammable pictogram toward a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 另一边，有人想在安全柜里蒸溶剂。

shots.scene: 小研同时伸手拦住两人
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises both hands to stop the young male student and the older man.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧拦住：两个都放错了！

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 我们一个一个来看。

shots.scene: 三台柜子的轮廓几乎一样
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet outlines that look almost identical side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 三种柜子都有玻璃窗、都有风，
overlay: 三种柜子，常被搞混

shots.scene: 三台柜子上方各出现一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A question mark appears above each of the three cabinet outlines. No people.
shots.narration: 但护的对象完全不同。

shots.scene: 化学通风柜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a chemical fume hood with its sash half open and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 先看化学通风柜。
overlay: 通风柜：护人，防吸入

shots.scene: 人形图标前挡着一面盾牌，挡住飘来的烟雾
shots.prompt_en: A shield in front of a person outline blocks drifting fumes, gas clouds and dust. No people.
shots.narration: 它保护做实验的人，

shots.scene: 蒸气、气体、粉尘、气溶胶四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: vapor wisps, a gas cloud, dust particles and fine mist droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 不吸入有害的蒸气、气体和粉尘。

shots.scene: 剖面图：室内空气从前面吸入通风柜
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram: room air arrows flow into the front opening of a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜从实验室吸入空气，
overlay: 通风柜：吸进来，排出去

shots.scene: 空气沿管道排出楼顶
shots.prompt_en: The arrows travel up an exhaust duct and out through the roof. No people.
shots.narration: 再通过管道排到室外。

shots.scene: 实验室里空气清新，没有烟雾积聚
shots.prompt_en: A lab room with clear air and no fumes building up, a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 有害物质就不会在室内积聚。

shots.scene: 冒着白雾的锥形瓶放在通风柜里
shots.prompt_en: Conical flasks giving off white wisps inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜常用来做化学反应、
overlay: 通风柜用来做什么

shots.scene: 旋转蒸发图标在通风柜内
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a solvent evaporating from an open dish inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 蒸发溶剂，

shots.scene: 带危险象形图的试剂瓶放进通风柜
shots.prompt_en: Reagent bottles with toxic and corrosive pictograms placed inside a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 以及其他用到有害化学品的操作。

shots.section_title: 通风柜：视窗拉低，头不进柜
shots.scene: 小研把视窗拉到标记线以下
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student lowers the fume hood sash below a marked line.
shots.narration: 用通风柜，视窗尽量拉低，
overlay: 通风柜：视窗拉低，头不进柜

shots.section_title: 通风柜：视窗拉低，头不进柜
shots.scene: 人头伸进通风柜的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person leaning their head inside a fume hood, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 头不要伸进柜子里。

shots.section_title: 通风柜：视窗拉低，头不进柜
shots.scene: 瓶子离开口有一段距离，后部排风口没有被挡
shots.prompt_en: Bottles placed well inside the fume hood, back exhaust slots clear and unblocked. No people.
shots.narration: 东西放里面些，别挡住排风口。

shots.section_title: 通风柜：视窗拉低，头不进柜
shots.scene: 风量指示灯变红，小研停下并关好视窗
shots.prompt_en: The fume hood airflow indicator turns red; the female graduate student stops and closes the sash.
shots.narration: 风量报警，就停用并报告。

shots.section_title: 超净台：无菌的工作空间
shots.scene: 超净工作台特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a clean bench with a clear work area and a blank label. No people.
shots.narration: 再看超净工作台。
overlay: 超净台：无菌的工作空间

shots.section_title: 超净台：无菌的工作空间
shots.scene: 无菌培养瓶和器材整齐放在台面上
shots.prompt_en: Sterile culture flasks and tools arranged neatly on the clean bench surface. No people.
shots.narration: 它给怕污染的材料，一个无菌的空间。

shots.section_title: 超净台：高效过滤净化空气
shots.scene: 剖面图：风机把空气推过过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a clean bench: a fan pushes air through a filter panel. No people.
shots.narration: 风机把空气推过高效过滤器，
overlay: 超净台：高效过滤净化空气

shots.section_title: 超净台：高效过滤净化空气
shots.scene: 过滤器一侧是灰尘点，另一侧是干净的空气
shots.prompt_en: Dust dots on one side of a filter, clean air arrows on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 灰尘和微生物被拦下，空气变干净。

shots.section_title: 超净台：单向气流防污染
shots.scene: 水平流和垂直流两种剖面图
shots.prompt_en: Two cutaway diagrams side by side: one with horizontal airflow arrows, one with vertical downward arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 干净的空气整齐地朝一个方向吹，
overlay: 超净台：单向气流防污染

shots.section_title: 超净台：单向气流防污染
shots.scene: 单向气流把灰尘点推离样品
shots.prompt_en: Parallel airflow arrows sweep dust dots away from an open culture flask. No people.
shots.narration: 把污染物吹离样品。

shots.scene: 小研在超净台里分装无菌培养基
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student dispenses sterile culture medium into flasks inside a clean bench.
shots.narration: 超净台适合制备细胞培养，
overlay: 超净台用来做什么

shots.scene: 无菌器材包在超净台内打开
shots.prompt_en: A sterile instrument pack opened on the clean bench surface. No people.
shots.narration: 处理无菌器材。

shots.scene: 水平流超净台的风吹向人形图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a horizontal clean bench with arrows blowing out of the front toward a person outline. No people.
shots.narration: 但要注意：它的风是吹向人的。

shots.scene: 带生物危害标志的培养皿放进超净台，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A culture dish with a biohazard warning sign being placed into a clean bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有感染性的微生物，不能在超净台做。

shots.section_title: 超净台里不用挥发性和有毒物
shots.scene: 溶剂瓶和有毒粉末瓶放进超净台，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A volatile solvent bottle and a toxic powder jar placed inside a clean bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 超净台也不能用挥发性溶剂，
overlay: 超净台里不用挥发性和有毒物

shots.section_title: 超净台里不用挥发性和有毒物
shots.scene: 蒸气被气流直接吹到操作者脸上
shots.prompt_en: Vapor wisps blown by the clean bench airflow straight toward a person outline's face. No people.
shots.narration: 风会把蒸气、粉末直接吹到你脸上。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：既无菌，又防护
shots.scene: 生物安全柜特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a biological safety cabinet with its front window at a marked height and a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 最后是生物安全柜。
overlay: 生物安全柜：既无菌，又防护

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：既无菌，又防护
shots.scene: 三个盾牌分别护着人、样品和地球
shots.prompt_en: Three shields protecting a person icon, a sample tube icon and a globe icon. No people.
shots.narration: 它像超净台一样护样品，还能护人、护环境。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：进出的空气都过滤
shots.scene: 剖面图：前窗吸入气流形成气帘
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway diagram of a biological safety cabinet: room air drawn in at the front window forms an air curtain. No people.
shots.narration: 空气从前窗吸入，挡住柜内气溶胶，
overlay: 生物安全柜：进出的空气都过滤

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：进出的空气都过滤
shots.scene: 柜内过滤后的气流从上往下吹
shots.prompt_en: Filtered air flows downward over the work surface inside the cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 过滤后的洁净气流从上往下吹，

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：进出的空气都过滤
shots.scene: 排风经过顶部过滤器才排出
shots.prompt_en: Exhaust air passes through a filter at the top of the cabinet before leaving. No people.
shots.narration: 排出的空气也要先经过高效过滤。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜：进出的空气都过滤
shots.scene: 通风柜和安全柜排风对比：一个不过滤，一个过滤
shots.prompt_en: Two diagrams compared: a fume hood exhaust going straight out, and a safety cabinet exhaust passing through a filter. No people.
shots.narration: 这一点，和通风柜不一样。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜分三级，按风险选
shots.scene: 三级生物安全柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Three cabinet icons: an open-front class one, a class two with a front window, and a sealed glove-box style class three. No people.

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜分三级，按风险选
shots.scene: 风险刻度从低到高，对应三台柜子
shots.prompt_en: A risk scale from low to high with the three cabinet icons placed along it. No people.
shots.narration: 风险越高，柜子的密闭程度越高。

shots.section_title: 生物安全柜分三级，按风险选
shots.scene: 循环箭头：识别、评估、确定、实施、复查
shots.prompt_en: A circular diagram with five arrows forming a loop, each with a small icon. No people.
shots.narration: 选哪一级，要靠风险评估来定。

shots.section_title: 风险等级：国内分类方向相反

shots.section_title: 风险等级：国内分类方向相反
shots.scene: 小研翻开空白目录核对
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank catalog book against a sample list.
shots.narration: 用什么柜子，以国内目录和评估为准。

shots.scene: 医学研究、临床检验、生物技术三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a research microscope, a clinical sample rack, and a bioreactor. No people.

shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里操作培养物
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, in a lab coat, goggles and gloves, handles cultures inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 临床诊断和生物技术领域。

shots.scene: 阿杰把细菌培养皿改放进生物安全柜

shots.narration: 阿杰的细菌实验，就该在这里做。

shots.scene: 柜子旁挂着空白使用登记本

shots.section_title: 共用设备：登记、清洁、交接
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白登记本上签名
shots.prompt_en: The young male student writes in the blank logbook before using the cabinet.
shots.narration: 用前登记，看上一位有没有异常。

shots.section_title: 共用设备：登记、清洁、交接
shots.scene: 阿杰用完擦拭消毒台面，清走物品

shots.scene: 柜子上挂空白故障牌，阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: A blank out-of-service tag hangs on a cabinet; the young male student reports to the older man.

shots.prompt_en: A biological safety cabinet icon next to shielded person, sample and globe icons. No people.
shots.narration: 生物安全柜：人、样品、环境都护。
